import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import solver
rng = random.Random(5)
bad = 0
for trial in range(300):
    R = rng.randint(1, 12)
    bursts = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):
        rep = rng.randint(1, 9)
        runs = [rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 6))]
        bursts.append((rep, runs))
    touch, qpref = solver.traffic(list(range(R)), bursts)
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            want_t = sum(rep for rep, runs in bursts if any(i <= r < j for r in runs))
            want_q = sum(rep * sum(1 for r in runs if i <= r < j) for rep, runs in bursts)
            if touch[i][j] != want_t or (qpref[j] - qpref[i]) != want_q:
                print('MISMATCH', R, i, j, touch[i][j], want_t, qpref[j]-qpref[i], want_q)
                bad += 1
print('traffic unit test: %d failures' % bad)
